{{Quote|Due to my systems' ability to monitor and repair themselves, you will find all the data within my archives has remained fully intact. Please choose the topic you wish information on.|Computer terminal in the Temple of the Ancients on Lehon|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A '''Rakata Computer''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] constructed by the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. These computers were used both as data archives, accessed through [[computer terminal]]s, and as devices for controlling doors or other systems. Due to the peculiarities of the technology, the systems of such computers were self-sufficient enough that they could repair themselves. As a consequence, after the fall of the Infinite Empire, the Rakata Computers survived tens of millennia. Two of these terminals were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], in the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|ruins]] near the [[Jedi Enclave]], and two more on the Rakatan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] visited the lower levels of the [[Temple of the Ancients]] on Lehon to search for any [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifacts]], eventually coming to the room with the remains of a massive Rakatan computer, which was broken beyond repair. While in the room, Bane finally found and retrieved [[Darth Revan's Sith Holocron]], which was hidden behind the stone in the wall behind the computer.<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>
